description: Realtime arrival/departure delays and cancellations at one Swiss station from the national GTFS-RT trip-update feed (opentransportdata.swiss). Input the 7-digit UIC station number (use search_stations to find it; e.g. 8503000 = Zürich HB, 8507000 = Bern). Returns GTFS trip_id/route_id, delay in minutes and status (CANCELED/SKIPPED). Requires env OPENTRANSPORTDATA_API_KEY (free). For line names and platforms prefer get_departures.

min_delay_minutes.description: Only trips delayed at least this much (cancellations always shown)

name: get_realtime_delays
title: Realtime delays at a station (GTFS-RT)
